Life can feel overwhelming when you’re carrying the weight of anxiety, trauma, relationship challenges, or major life changes. When you’re in the middle of a struggle, it’s often difficult to see a clear path forward. Sometimes what makes the biggest difference is having a compassionate, unbiased person beside you who can offer an outside perspective and help you make sense of what you’re experiencing.

name: Joseph Kirby
bio:
People choose to enter therapy for many reasons, but ultimately the reason for most people is that we want to feel better. Suffering may be an inescapable part of being human, but that's not all there is. When people are given a compassionate space where they can be open and vulnerable, they discover insights and strengths that can help them approach life with a new perspective and make healthy changes.
